xfield_correction: The previous parser incorrectly treated the xfield area as inline {type u8, length u8, value[]} entries. The authoritative layout is apfs_xf_blob {xf_num_exts u16, xf_used_data u16} followed by contiguous apfs_x_field {x_type u8, x_flags u8, x_size u16} metadata entries, with values starting after ALL metadata, each consuming round_up(x_size, 8) bytes. The corrected parser walks metadata first, then reads values at computed offsets.

decmpfs_finding.storage_mode: DATA_EMBEDDED (0x2) — compressed data inline in XATTR value, no dstream/resource fork needed
decmpfs_finding.implications: No zlib/LZFSE/LZVN decoder is needed for this fixture. The file content can be reconstructed by reading xdata[16:] (after the decmpfs header: signature u32 + algo u32 + logical_size u64). The APFS_INOBSD_COMPRESSED flag is set but algorithm 9 means the payload is plain. This closes the read-only file byte chain: DIR_REC -> INODE -> XATTR(decmpfs) -> embedded plain bytes -> logical file content.
decmpfs_finding.algorithm_name: PLAIN_ATTR — data is NOT actually compressed; bytes are stored verbatim after the 16-byte decmpfs header
